events.title: Spring Tasting: Wines of Piedmont
events.description: Explore the noble wines of Piedmont — from everyday Barbera to elegant Barolo. Four carefully selected wines presented by Laudrup Vin, paired with Italian cheese and charcuterie.

events.title: Natural Wine Evening
events.description: Curious about natural wine? Join us for a guided tasting of four distinctive natural wines from France and Italy, presented by Cruvin.dk.

events.title: Champagne & Sparkling Masterclass
events.description: A festive evening of bubbles — comparing Champagne with Crémant, Cava, and Prosecco. Presented by Otto Suenson with expert commentary.

events.title: Intro to Wine Tasting
events.description: Our semester opener — learn the basics of wine tasting with four approachable wines. Perfect for beginners and curious minds.
